title: Store template assignments by reference
description: Model a template position assignment as template identity plus per-label typed data and optional allow-listed overrides, never as a copied component tree.
acceptanceCriteria: A template assignment stores template identity, input values, and optional constrained overrides only
The persisted assignment contains no duplicate of the referenced template content tree
Template identity must resolve to a compatible version or produce a structured assignment diagnostic
Overrides target stable node/property identities and reject structural, executable, or unsupported changes
Two assignments can reference one template with distinct valid values

steps.details: Add a discriminated template-assignment value with assignment identity, template identity/version, typed data map, and optional allow-listed override records.
Resolve the template, validate input names/values, and permit overrides only for documented stable node properties without copying or restructuring the tree.
Create a pure resolution result containing generation-ready values plus assignment/input/property diagnostics while leaving stored template and assignment unchanged.
Serialize two assignments to one template, assert no content tree appears in either record, and cover missing template, stale version, invalid value, and forbidden override cases.

technicalNotes: Timebox to one assignment union and resolver seam; authoring UI belongs to later tasks.
Resolved content is derived generation state, not authoring truth or an incidental save format.
